Exactly right! Since it's a live plant, yes — the replacement will ship **Monday to Wednesday only**.

So once the courier investigation wraps up (up to **5 business days**), the replacement will go out on the next available plant shipping day, which could be as soon as Monday if the timing lines up, or a bit later if it lands on a Thursday or beyond.

I know you've been waiting a while already, so I really appreciate your patience. 

To get that investigation started and moving, I just need your **order number** (`LF-` followed by six digits). Please don't share any full card numbers, security codes, or passwords.

Thanks again, and I'm here if you need anything else! 🌱
